questions.text: Can you tell me what you do?
questions.say: Good afternoon. My name is Isabella, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about what you do. Can you tell me what you do?

questions.text: Do you take work or study home with you?

questions.text: How do you relax after a long day of work or study?

questions.text: Do you use English in your work or studies?

Now let's move on to talk about sunglasses. Do you wear sunglasses?

questions.text: Describe a time when you lost something.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you lost something. You should say: what you lost; where and when you lost it; what you did to find it; and explain how you felt when you lost it.

questions.text: Did you learn anything from this experience?
questions.say: Thank you. Did you learn anything from this experience?

questions.text: What kinds of things do people lose most often?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you lost something, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all losing things. What kinds of things do people lose most often?

questions.text: Why do some people lose things more often than others?
questions.say: Why do some people lose things more often than others?

questions.text: How can technology help people to find things they have lost?
questions.say: How can technology help people to find things they have lost?

questions.text: What should people do if they find something valuable in the street?
questions.say: Now let's talk about honesty. What should people do if they find something valuable in the street?

questions.text: Do you think people are more honest in small towns than in big cities?
questions.say: Do you think people are more honest in small towns than in big cities?

questions.text: How can parents teach their children to be honest?
questions.say: How can parents teach their children to be honest?
